full_judgment: (b) "Khatian has been opened and finally published as per deed as such if there is any objection against the recording the defendants ought to have filed an objection in the Settlement Department but they did not do that. Over and above it appears from the Income Tax Assessment Roll that the plaintiff and the defendants paid the income tax according to their share and cleared up Municipal dues accordingly".
